journey.name: profile removal recovery
journey.description: Use a disposable authenticated profile and controlled homeserver/operation/storage faults. These fault gates are outside the standard Capabilities; no live funds or wallet wipe is needed. Keep a redacted operation counter. Recreate the fixture separately for each failure checkpoint. Local Disconnect does not assert remote deletion. Conditional contact deletion across devices is not proved by local ownership, and requires the separate native CAS fixture.

actions.action: Open Edit Profile, request deletion and verify preparation opens a confirmation without a mutation
Confirm once, lose a mutation acknowledgement and verify failure feedback without success or automatic replay
Tap Review and verify only read-only reconciliation runs before a new confirmation appears
In separate fixtures, edit the profile or change or add a contact after the failure and verify Review rejects the changed targets without a mutation
Review unchanged remaining records, then recreate a record that was observed absent and verify a later Review cannot add it back to this attempt
Cancel that confirmation and verify the mutation count does not increase
Choose Disconnect from the failure options and verify a separate local-only confirmation appears
Cancel local Disconnect and verify neither local cleanup nor remote mutation runs
Confirm local Disconnect while credential erasure is unavailable and verify recovery remains pending without clearing consumed-payment-list safety state
Restore local storage, restart after credential erasure but before local completion and open Profile
Verify pending cleanup and Disconnect remain visible with no stored identity, no authenticated activation and no automatic remote mutation
Background and foreground the app, then reconnect the test device network; verify cleanup guidance remains available without an expired-session or reconnect-profile error
Confirm local Disconnect and verify all required local cleanup finishes before leaving Profile
In a fresh fixture, replace the sign-in before an old confirmation or completion is delivered and verify it cannot act on or navigate away from the replacement
Open ordinary receive and verify address accounting remains available while profile cleanup is pending
